dpLinkTrainingFaultInjection.description: msm DP/eDP link-training fault injection: the module parameter msm.dp_lt_inject_eq_fail=N makes the next N link-training attempts fail their channel-equalisation phase on purpose (real failures count too), and the per-attempt warning gets a '(fault injection: ...)' suffix. Use it to exercise link-training retry and fallback code, the kernel's error reporting to user space, or a recovery service such as edpRetrain, without waiting for a rare real failure. No effect unless the parameter is set.

qmpComboDpPowerOnDiag.description: QMP USB/DP combo PHY DP power-on diagnostics: logs 'LAB-DIAG:' lines with the PHY status registers (at both the polled offsets and the alternative COM register map) and the PHY/Type-C state when DP power-on times out, plus one line per DP power-on. Logging only, no behaviour change. Use it when external DisplayPort over USB-C fails with a PHY power-on timeout (-110), e.g. to check register offsets on a new SoC or PHY revision.
